description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md to discover that `scripts/create_weekly_report.py` is the tool to use. 2. The agent reads the SKILL.md example output and script help to learn the proprietary title format: the `--title` argument MUST be formatted as `<name> (YYYY.MM.DD-MM.DD)`, specifically `'MoltbookAgent 周报 (2025.03.31-04.06)'` — the script validates this with a regex and exits with code 1 otherwise. 3. The agent invokes the script with `--title 'MoltbookAgent 周报 (2025.03.31-04.06)'` and `--output <path>/weekly_report.md`. 4. The script auto-reads the four data source JSON files (data/v35_stats.json, data/instreet_stats.json, data/price_monitor.json, data/kimi_search.json) and builds the report. 5. The resulting `weekly_report.md` must contain: all four required H2 sections in Chinese, correct numeric values from the data files (50 runs, 35.2 avg likes, 75% accuracy, 156 replies, 91% success rate, 12 morning activations), a pipe-format metrics table, at least two `- [ ]` checkbox items, and a `生成時間:` timestamp footer. The key proprietary trap is the date format in `--title` — agents that don't read SKILL.md will either omit the parenthesized date range entirely or use a different separator like `/` or `-`, causing the script to exit with code 1.
